subtitles.text: My mother is a computer Today, if someone says my mother is a computer, you probably think that their mom is a robot.
However, before the invention of modern electronic computers, the word computer used to mean a job that a person would do.
A computer was someone who did computation.
Computers were usually women.
Some people, such as technicians, architects, or bankers, needed to know the answers to difficult mathematical calculations.
They did not always have the time or skills to compute these calculations.
So they hired a computer, someone whose job it is to compute large, difficult calculations.
The first computation machines For thousands of years, people have used a tool called an abacus.
To do difficult calculations.
An abacus is a kind of computer because it computes calculations.
Perhaps the first computation machine.
Machine that looks like a modern computer was invented by the French mathematician Blaise Pascal.
In 1640, Pascal made an arithmetic machine.
which he used to count money quickly and accurately.
Later, in sixteen seventy, a German scientist called Gottfried Leibniz continued Pascal's work and made a machine called the step reckoner.
It could do more advanced calculations than Pascal's arithmetic machine.
The step reckoner used only two digits, zero and one, to do its calculations.
This system, called binary, is still the system that modern computers use today.
Much later, in the 1820s, a British mathematician named Charles Babbage invented a machine called the difference engine, which could do even more advanced computations.
Later, Babbage invented an even more advanced machine, the analytical engine, which could do more complex calculations because it had.
A simple kind of memory.
Because the analytical engine had a memory, you could write programs for it.
Because of this, the analytical engine is often considered to be the first real.
computer.
It was a machine that used binary, had memory, and could be programmed.
Ada Lovelace, another mathematician, Made a program for the analytical engine.
That means Ada Lovelace was the first computer programmer in history.
In 1979, computer scientists named A programming language after Lovelace called Ada.
The first modern computers.
People in the nineteenth century invented some more machines.
That are like modern computers, such as the German inventor Konrad Zusa, who made a machine called the Z1.
The Z1 and his later machine.
The Z2, Z3, and Z4 used binary ones and zeros and could be programmed.
Zeus's machines were more efficient than previous ones, but they took up more space.
The Z one was so large it took up the entire living room at Zeus's house.
Perhaps the most important computer scientist is Alan Turing.
Turing was a mathematician who started working for the British Government in nineteen thirty nine.
During the Second World War, the German army sent messages to their soldiers with a machine called the Enigma Machine.
The Enigma Machine changed the messages into a secret code, so the British could not understand the messages.
Turing and other mathematicians made a computer called Bomba to Decode and understand the secret German messages.
Then, in 1943, the Germans created a new code, which the British called.
fish.
In just one year, Turing and his team made a big computer called Colossus that could understand this secret German code.
Colossus was the world's first electronic computer that could read and understand programs.
Colossus got its name from its size.
The computer took up an entire room.
Colossus could do thousands of calculations every second.
Colossus could decode a message in about two hours.
The same message would take a team of three mathematicians over six weeks to decode.
A modern PC is not much faster than Colossus.
But a modern PC is much, much smaller.
With Colossus, Turin helped win the war against Nazi Germany.
Despite Turin's efforts, the British government did not treat him very well after the war.
Turin was a gay man, and at the time, the British government did not like people who are gay.
So they treated him badly.
Today, however, we remember Turing as a hero, and people often call him the father of computers.
because he created the first electronic computer.
Computers have advanced a lot since Turing's Colossus computer.
Today, there are many specialized jobs in the field of computer science.
